goal: Audit all checklist-engine requirements, exact data/source needs and delivered evidence; reconcile both owner-supplied Gantt charts and publish a traceable corrected status report.
why: Advances the assigned Venice lane row for the Cyrus full-repository audit and prevents missing requirements or false completion claims before any world/scoring/live gate is considered.
gantt_row: All project stages 0-8; evidence audit only

tasks.title: Seed docs/venice-audit-v1/PROGRESS.json on the created audit branch as durable fallback

tasks.title: Build DATA_REQUIREMENTS.csv (one row per canonical id) and SOURCE_MANIFEST.json from authority files

tasks.title: Verify each claim against immutable main evidence (coverage CSVs, catalog audit json, source status/proof summaries, receipts)

tasks.title: Publish REQUIREMENTS.csv, GANTT_COMPARISON.csv, corrected GANTT.html and dependency-ordered AUDIT.md under docs/venice-audit-v1/
tasks.acceptance: All required artifacts present on the audit branch, no writes outside allowed_paths, every percentage carries numerator/denominator/scope or is UNKNOWN

tasks.title: Add validator script and source-matched test, then open PR and merge to main
tasks.acceptance: Workflow run on venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1 is green with the pytest step actually executing, and merge_pr returns a merge commit on main for the exact expected_head_sha
